offers.name: Apple MacBook Pro 16.2" (2026) - Space Black (Apple M5 Pro / 24GB RAM / 1TB SSD) - English

reviews.quote: The new Apple M5 Pro SoC is a perfect fit for the MacBook Pro 16 because it can utilize the full performance of the chip without throttling. We see noticeable performance advantages over the previous M4 Pro chip (~20 % CPU, 30-50 % GPU).
premium workstation laptop designed for creative and professional work... outstanding build quality with premium materials and incredible fit and finish

praises: The M5 Pro hits its full performance in the 16-inch chassis without any throttling (NBC)
Stays very quiet in most scenarios even under sustained load (NBC)
Mini-LED panel is still among the best and the matte option is a big advantage over most rivals (NBC)
Thunderbolt 5 and much faster PCIe 5.0 SSDs versus the previous generation (NBC)
The 16-inch speaker system and keyboard are the best Apple ships (NBC and RTINGS)
complaints: Prices are still high, especially when you add upgrades (NBC con)
Battery runtime is a bit shorter than the previous M4 Pro unit (NBC)
Still no SD Express support in the card reader (NBC con)
Wi-Fi 7 module limited to 160 MHz, capping rates around 2 Gbps (NBC)
2.14 kg plus the 140W brick makes this a desk-first laptop (RTINGS)

design_philosophy: The 16-inch is the chassis the Pro chip was made for: NBC's testing shows the bigger cooling headroom lets the M5 Pro run at full power indefinitely. It trades portability for the best display, speakers, and thermal behaviour Apple currently sells.
rating_notes: Directly tested config (NBC 92.3% Editor's Choice on the M5 Pro 18-core/20-core; RTINGS 8.2 on the M5 2026 16-inch chassis). Image URL is Apple's own specs-page CDN jpg; site fallback applies if it rotates. Sentiment synthesized from pro reviews — Reddit API blocked (403).
